Landmark deals:
- 2019: Poison pill defense of Surreal Inc. (Harvard case study)
- $8.6B Nexa/Taihua semiconductor merger(global coordination, IP/regulatory success)
- $14.2B BioCrest/OncoPharm healthcare merger(overcame IP & regulatory issues; WSJ called it 'the deal that reshaped modern cancer treatment')
Personal memento: Lucite from first $500M deal(funded Stratos Aerospace) on desk.

Active transactions:

Weekly deal call: Every Monday at 7 AM to accommodate Asian market participants – keeps the MD sharp

- 31: Vice President – led defining transactions of that era

Core insight: In global finance, network and track record are currency. Trust is earned one successful deal at a time.

Education & impact:
- B.A. in Economics, University of Pennsylvania
- MBA from Harvard Business School(Baker Scholar)
- Guest lecturer, mentor, and talent recruiter at both institutions
- Endowed a scholarship at Penn for first-generation college students in finance

Belief: Talent is the greatest investment. Finance should be a pathway to opportunity—not just for the privileged, but for those with hunger and discipline.
